messages:
kevin: Heads up — I just noticed cross-tenant rows in the console. Opened ACME org view and saw runs from org_xxx. Could be a scoping/caching bug.
maria: can repro on my end. steps: /console/org/ACME/runs -> applied saved filter -> results contain org_xxx runs.
owen: quick glance at runlist traces — some cached responses have null workspace_id and later get rendered under the wrong org.
kevin: here's the curl I used to reproduce:
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \"https://console.internal/api/runs?org=ACME\"
```
response included items with "org_id": "org_xxx"
maria: suspect header bleed. nginx proxy config had `proxy_set_header X-Workspace $http_x_workspace;` which might be preserving an upstream header.
ownen: router/routing-policy introduced last week injects X-Workspace based on session cookie for dedicated clusters — if proxy blindly forwards, header can leak across internal calls.
tori: @infra-bot can you pull the deploy history and recent config changes for proxy and runlist?
infra-bot: deploys in the window: proxy v1.9.3 (deploy-id d-8891) -> 2026-03-19T17:12, runlist v2.11 (deploy-id d-8890) -> 2026-03-19T17:10
kevin: mitigation idea: unset X-Workspace at the proxy before forwarding to runlist and mark runlist responses Cache-Control: private to avoid shared edge caching across org keys.
maria: opened PR 4051: runlist will sanitize `X-Workspace` and include org in cache key. Pushed to staging; running basic smoke tests.
ownen: long-term we need router to not rely on injected headers and instead use auth token-scoped org from internal auth middleware. Headers are too brittle.
kevin: agree. short-term hotfix + limited rollback if needed. we need to treat this as potential data exposure. @console-sre open incident page? we should also surface to trust/legal.
console-sre: incident INC-2026-0319-runlist-scope-bleed created. severity P1 due to possible cross-tenant data exposure. canary rollback of proxy v1.9.3 started in eu-west.
maria: pushed hotfix to prod (runlist patch + cache invalidation). CDN invalidation triggered. rollout paused at 1% canary.
ownen: logs: 42 mismatched-run entries in last 15m, originating from host proxy-3.internal. Filtering by request path shows `/api/runs` only.
kevin: adding quick telemetry: counting responses where returned_org_id != requested_org param. running query now.
maria: also found a tiny UI bug: quick-switch leaves old org_id in localStorage sometimes, letting UI render stale results even after switching — fixing that in the same PR.
kevin: next steps: 1) confirm hotfix stops mismatches, 2) complete rollback if not, 3) postmortem with timeline and disclosure recommendation, 4) add automated tests for header sanitation and cache-keying, 5) router/auth refactor follow-up.
console-sre: elevated to SEV P1 and added oncall rotation. will update incident doc with deploy ids and counts.
kevin: I'll ping trust/legal for disclosure guidance and draft a short note for affected customers if needed. thanks everyone — keep updates here and drop deploy ids and regression numbers.
maria: patched, smoke looks good on staging, monitoring for 30m.
kevin: :thumbsup:
